external_entities.name: supplier
external_entities.description: Supplier that uploads compliance paperwork and signs in to the vendor platform.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal
external_entities.notes: Suppliers' paperwork includes contact details for their own staff.

external_entities.name: category manager
external_entities.description: Category manager who reviews uploaded supplier paperwork and approves or rejects it.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.

external_entities.name: vendor
external_entities.description: Vendor that hosts the SaaS platform and issues supplier credentials.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

external_entities.name: vendor platform
external_entities.description: Vendor-hosted SaaS platform providing the supplier document portal.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.
external_entities.notes: The vendor's datasheet says the platform is secure by design, uses enterprise-grade encryption throughout, that all access is fully authenticated and audited, and that the product is fully compliant.

processes.name: supplier master service
processes.description: Service that loads the nightly supplier data extract and writes records into the supplier database.
processes.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_stores.name: landing bucket
data_stores.description: Cloud landing bucket receiving the nightly supplier data extract.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_stores.notes: The runbook says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is.

data_stores.name: supplier database
data_stores.description: Database containing records loaded from the supplier data extract.
data_stores.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Supplier signs in to the vendor platform.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers sign in with a username and password that the vendor issues to them.

data_flows.name: upload paperwork
data_flows.description: Supplier uploads compliance paperwork and staff contact details to the vendor platform.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal — insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for their own staff.
data_flows.data_description: Insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for supplier staff

data_flows.name: review paperwork
data_flows.description: Category manager reviews uploaded paperwork and approves or rejects it in the vendor platform.
data_flows.source_excerpt: review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it
data_flows.data_description: Uploaded supplier compliance paperwork and approval or rejection decisions

data_flows.name: issue credentials
data_flows.description: Vendor issues supplier usernames and passwords.

data_flows.name: push extract
data_flows.description: Vendor platform pushes the nightly supplier data extract to the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_flows.notes: The source says the nightly extract is encrypted end to end, but the runbook says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is. These claims do not establish a single encryption value.

data_flows.name: load file
data_flows.description: Supplier master service loads the extract file from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file

data_flows.name: write records
data_flows.description: Supplier master service writes extracted records into the supplier database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database

trust_boundaries.name: vendor hosting
trust_boundaries.description: Vendor-hosted environment in which the SaaS platform runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: Corporate network from which category managers work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: Our cloud account containing the landing bucket, supplier master service, and supplier database.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier data held or carried by the landing bucket is confidential.
assumptions.basis: The bucket stores supplier compliance paperwork and contact details for supplier staff.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier records held by the supplier database are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The database stores supplier records derived from compliance paperwork and staff contact details.
